### `dp_deinit_lane`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `initialize` | Initialize the Data Path associated with host lane &lt;lane&gt; |
| 0x01 | `deinitialize` | Deinitialize the Data Path associated with host lane &lt;lane&gt; |

### `output_disable_tx`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `enabled` | Tx output enabled for media lane &lt;lane&gt; |
| 0x01 | `disabled` | Tx output disabled for media lane &lt;lane&gt; |

### `auto_squelch_disable_tx`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `enabled` | Automatic Tx output squelching control enabled for media lane &lt;lane&gt; |
| 0x01 | `disabled` | Automatic Tx output squelching control disabled for media lane &lt;lane&gt; |

### `output_squelch_force_tx`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `no_impact` | No impact on Tx output for media lane &lt;lane&gt; |
| 0x01 | `squelched` | Tx output squelched for media lane &lt;lane&gt; |

### `adaptive_input_eq_store_tx`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `reserved_0` | Reserved |
| 0x01 | `store_to_buffer_1` | Store to recall buffer 1 |
| 0x02 | `store_to_buffer_2` | Store to recall buffer 2 |
| 0x03 | `reserved_3` | Reserved |

### `output_disable_rx`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `enabled` | Rx output enabled for lane &lt;lane&gt; |
| 0x01 | `disabled` | Rx output disabled for lane &lt;lane&gt; |

### `auto_squelch_disable_rx`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `enabled` | Automatic Rx output squelching enabled for host lane &lt;lane&gt; |
| 0x01 | `disabled` | Automatic Rx output squelching disabled for host lane &lt;lane&gt; |

|---|---|---|

| 0x01 | `recall_buffer_1` | Recall buffer 1 |
| 0x02 | `recall_buffer_2` | Recall buffer 2 |
| 0x03 | `reserved` | Reserved |

### `scs1_adaptive_input_eq_recall_tx`

|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `do_not_recall` | Do not recall |
